svg.title: When something breaks: where to look, then clean up
svg.desc: The tour: six symptoms each point to the place to look. Create failed points to Deployments, who changed it to the Activity log, VM black screen or Unknown to Resource health and boot diagnostics, cannot sign in to the Microsoft Entra sign-in logs, quota or provider error to Usage and quotas, and RDP will not connect to Network Watcher IP flow verify. The clean up, in order: first remove locks and policy assignments. Then check role assignments and destroy the Terraform project in rg-azb-tf. Then delete rg-azb-sandbox and rg-azb-lab and wait until they are gone. Then purge the soft-deleted key vault. Then remove the Microsoft Entra leftovers: the device vm-azb-win01, the storage account app and any Conditional Access policy. Last, check Cost analysis the next day. A green box keeps rg-azb-core with ag-azb-email, the subscription budget budget-azb-core, testuser1, TestUsers and the emergency accounts.
svg.text: check TestUsers roles, terraform destroy in rg-azb-tf
